verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents general data export ('retain full ownership of all payment and merchant data and may export it at any time') and a Platform Portal where merchant info can be managed, but there is no evidence of dedicated per-seller statements, payout reconciliation reports, or bookkeeper-ready exports that let sellers self-serve without contacting ops. missing for 10: seller-facing statement generation, payout reconciliation reports, dedicated bookkeeper export formats, self-serve portal access for sellers.
